nodes.text:
#Breaking 
- TWO CASES of #HMPV detected in #Karnataka, says India’s Health Ministry. 
- ICMR detected two cases of HMPV in state- one is a 3-month female infant. She was hospitalised and discharged
- Another is an 8-month infant who tested positive for HMPV on Jan 3rd. 
-

nodes.author: JaiKrishhhh
nodes.text: @RishikaSadam Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus that typically causes symptoms similar to the common cold. It belongs to the Pneumoviridae family, which also includes the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).

nodes.author: JaiKrishhhh
nodes.text:
@RishikaSadam Symptoms: Common symptoms of HMPV infection include:

Cough
Fever
Runny or stuffy nose
Sore throat
Wheezing
Shortness of breath
Rash

nodes.author: RishikaSadam
nodes.text:
Further, ICMR also says no unusual surge in ILI or SARI cases (respiratory illnesses) in the country.
